observedIssues.message: One long-output request ended without a finish reason and was rejected. No completed candidate was created.
A requested single-word change also replaced 作者 with author. Diff review remains necessary.
Two earlier 60-second test rounds were stopped; desktop debugging and wall-clock waits also interfered. These are not sufficient evidence to attribute the delay solely to the provider.
